Professional Smart Lighting Installation

Automated Lighting Designed for Your Home

Performance Home Automation provides professional smart lighting installation for new construction, renovations, and existing homes. Our lighting control installers coordinate fixtures, dimmers, keypads, sensors, programming, and compatible home automation technology to create one intuitive system.

An automated lighting system can provide centralized control of individual fixtures, entire rooms, outdoor areas, or the whole property. Customized scenes and schedules make it easy to prepare your home for mornings, entertaining, relaxing, bedtime, travel, and other everyday activities.

From initial lighting design and equipment selection through installation, programming, testing, and support, every system is customized around the property and the homeowner’s needs.

Lighting Design for New Construction & Custom Homes

Plan Your Lighting Before Construction Is Complete

Building a new home is the ideal time to involve a professional lighting designer. Our team works with homeowners, architects, interior designers, builders, and electricians to develop a comprehensive lighting plan for new homes before fixtures, wiring, and controls are finalized.

From architectural lighting and fixture placement to automated lighting control and customized scenes, thoughtful lighting design for custom homes helps ensure lighting is incorporated into the architecture from the beginning rather than treated as an afterthought.

Architectural Lighting Design

Highlighting the Features of Your Home

Architectural lighting design uses carefully placed illumination to support the architecture, interior design, and function of each space. Our residential lighting designers consider fixture placement, beam angles, brightness, color temperature, dimming, finishes, and control when developing a complete lighting plan.

Thoughtfully designed architectural lighting can highlight artwork, cabinetry, ceilings, textured surfaces, exterior details, and other defining features while providing comfortable illumination for everyday activities.

Understanding Light Layering

Accent lighting draws attention to your home's most distinctive features. By highlighting artwork, architectural details, textured walls, and decorative elements, accent lighting adds depth, visual interest, and a sophisticated finishing touch to any space.

Task

Task lighting delivers focused illumination where you need it most. From under-cabinet kitchen lighting and desk lamps to vanity and pendant lighting, task lighting improves visibility, reduces eye strain, and enhances everyday functionality.

Accent

Ambient lighting serves as the foundation of your lighting design, providing balanced illumination throughout a space. Whether through recessed lights, chandeliers, or ceiling fixtures, it creates a comfortable atmosphere while enhancing the beauty and functionality of your home.

Ambient

Picking Your Color Temperature

Selecting the right color temperature is an important part of lighting design. Warm lighting (2700K–3000K) creates a comfortable, inviting atmosphere that is ideal for living rooms, bedrooms, and entertaining spaces. Cooler lighting (4000K–5000K) provides brighter, more focused illumination, making it well-suited for kitchens, offices, and task-oriented areas. By choosing the proper color temperature for each room, you can improve comfort, functionality, and the overall ambiance of your home.

Smart Lighting Control Systems in Annapolis, MD

Energy Efficiency/Savings

  • Motion-Based Automation
    Motion sensors automatically turn lights on and off in frequently used spaces, reducing energy waste and improving convenience.

  • Daylight Harvesting
    Smart lighting systems adjust brightness based on available natural light, maximizing efficiency and reducing unnecessary energy use.

  • Automated Schedules
    Create custom lighting schedules that align with your daily routine, helping reduce energy consumption while enhancing comfort and convenience.

Convenience & Customization

  • Smart Control
    Control your lights from anywhere using a smartphone, keypad, or voice assistant for effortless convenience.

  • Custom Lighting Scenes
    Create personalized lighting scenes for entertaining, relaxing, dining, or movie nights with a single touch.

  • Vacation Mode
    Automatically vary lighting schedules while you're away to make your home appear occupied and enhance security.

Security & Safety

  • Motion-Activated Lighting
    Outdoor lights automatically illuminate when motion is detected, improving visibility and helping deter unwanted visitors.

  • Pathway & Night Lighting
    Low-level lighting activates when needed, making it safer to navigate hallways, stairways, and walkways after dark.

  • Enhanced Home Security
    Automated schedules and smart lighting controls can make your home appear occupied while you're away, adding an extra layer of security.

Human-Centric Lighting

Experience lighting that works in harmony with your body's natural rhythm. By automatically adjusting color temperature throughout the day, human-centric lighting enhances comfort, supports wellness, improves focus, and creates a more natural living environment.
